gate_reclassification.QR_V2_SCAN_PASS: NOT_PROVEN (parse observed working on device; gate not certified)

root_cause_statement: The pairing claim request failed at the TRANSPORT layer before any HTTP response (typed IOException → NETWORK_UNREACHABLE → PAIRING_ENDPOINT_UNREACHABLE). The live Tower public plane (hermestower.aclclouds.online) is healthy and serves the v2 claim and attest routes, so the endpoint carried by the QR was not reachable from the phone (4G cellular at failure time). Surviving classes: LAN-only endpoint, Tailscale-only endpoint, cleartext-http endpoint (blocked by Android NSC), private-TLS endpoint. Exact class pending one piece of Owner/Tower evidence.
